overlap_note.hold_5d: entry=signal+1 open; exit=signal+1+5 open (= next 5d signal's entry). Periods abut, do NOT overlap.
overlap_note.hold_20d: signals every 4th 5d-signal (=20 trading days); entry=signal+1 open; exit=signal+1+20 open (= next 20d signal's entry). Periods abut, do NOT overlap.
overlap_note.retained_names: If a name is in next period's Top5, sell cost is waived (buffer/continuity); still one continuous economic holding across the abutting periods.
overlap_note.cash_slots: Skipped slots (ST/suspend/limit-up) contribute 0 return; capital stays in cash for that 1/K.
overlap_note.dividends: Open-to-open returns use O/F (forward-adjusted), so cash/stock dividends between entry and exit are in the return.
overlap_note.st_rule_2026_07_06: p4lib.st_proxy: before 2026-07-06 main-board ST lock ≈5%; on/after that date the historical 5% proxy is frozen and OR'd with current ST names. Limit-up/down flags in world use date-appropriate board limits.
